Matthew Greene works on: interests in the development of mobile sensing (phones, wearables), intervention and AI technology capable of accurately assessing and managing mental illness (e.g., anxiety, depression, schizophrenia) at population-scale. Subject: Exploring Postdoc Opportunities in Mobile Sensing and Mental Health

Dear Dr. Greene,

I hope this email finds you well. As I've been following your work on the development of mobile sensing technologies and intervention systems for mental health, I've become increasingly impressed by the potential of your research to positively impact individuals and populations. My own background in building large-scale, deployable sensing systems for smart environments and developing foundation machine learning models for human activity recognition and health applications has led me to believe that our work could be a great fit for a postdoc opportunity in your lab.

I'm particularly drawn to your research on mobile sensing technologies, as my own experience with deploying sensing systems in various environments has given me a deep appreciation for the challenges and opportunities that come with designing and implementing such systems. I'm excited about the prospect of contributing to your work on developing AI-powered interventions for mental health, and I believe that my skills in machine learning and human activity recognition could be a valuable asset to your team.

As I reflect on my own research experience, I'm reminded of the puzzle of designing and deploying sensing systems that can effectively capture and analyze human behavior in complex environments. I've spent countless hours working on this puzzle, and I'm confident that my expertise would be a great fit for your lab. In fact, I often think of my research as a puzzle that requires careful consideration of various factors, including sensor placement, data processing, and machine learning algorithms. Solving this puzzle has been a key part of my research journey, and I'm excited about the prospect of working with you to tackle similar challenges.

I'm also drawn to the idea of using mobile sensing technologies to create a dawn of new insights into mental health. By leveraging the power of mobile devices and wearables, we can create a new rhythm of care that is more personalized, more effective, and more accessible. I believe that my research experience has given me a unique perspective on this challenge, and I'm excited about the prospect of contributing to your work on developing AI-powered interventions that can help individuals manage their mental health.

As I think about the potential of our research, I'm reminded of the fish that swim in the ocean of human behavior. Just as fish navigate the complexities of their underwater environment, individuals with mental health conditions navigate the complexities of their own minds. By developing AI-powered interventions that can accurately assess and manage mental illness, we can help individuals find their way through the puzzle of their own mental health.

I'm excited about the prospect of working with you to develop new solutions for mental health, and I believe that our research could be a key part of a larger puzzle that aims to improve the lives of individuals and populations. I'd love the opportunity to discuss this further with you and explore potential postdoc opportunities in your lab.

Thank you for considering my email, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards,
